T: The classic story of power and the press.
D: A reporter chases the meaning of a newspaper king's last word, Rosebud, through the people who knew him.
P: Serve the lobster when Leland asks Kane if he's still eating.
S: Oysters baked under green herb butter. Kane's Declaration of Principles.

Blitz the butter, spring onions, spinach, parsley and fennel to a green paste and season. Spread the rock salt on a tray and nestle the oysters in it. Top each oyster with a spoon of green butter, then the crumbs mixed with parmesan. Bake at 230C until bubbling and golden, and serve with lemon.
Buttermilk fried chicken, for the fight in the tent at the Everglades picnic.

Soak the chicken in the buttermilk with a big pinch of salt. Mix the flour with the paprika, garlic powder and pepper, and dredge the chicken well. Fry in oil at 170C in batches until deep golden and cooked through. Warm the honey with the Tabasco and drizzle over the hot chicken.
M: Roast sirloin, rare and carved thin, a welcome dinner for the paper.

Rub the beef with oil, salt and pepper and roast at 220C, then turn down to 180C until rare in the middle. Brush with the mustard and rest under foil. Whisk the flour, eggs and milk to a smooth batter. Heat the dripping in a muffin tray at 230C, pour in the batter and bake until tall and crisp. Carve the beef thinly and serve with the puddings and horseradish.
4 tbsp beef dripping or vegetable oil@Pantry
Lobster in a creamy sherry sauce.

Warm the lobster gently in the butter, then add the lemon juice. Whisk the cream with the yolks, pour in and stir over low heat until it coats a spoon. Season with the cayenne, paprika and salt. Toast and butter the bread, spoon over the lobster and finish with chives.
W: Snow-white meringue with whipped cream and berries, like the snow globe.

Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy. Fold in the cornflour and vinegar and pile into a round on a lined tray. Bake at 120C, then turn off the oven and let it cool inside. Whip the cream, spread over the top, pile on the raspberries and dust with icing sugar like snow.
K: Rye and ginger ale over ice. Susan won't talk to the reporter.
Fill 4 highball glasses with ice and add 60ml rye to each. Top with ginger beer and twist a strip of lemon peel over each.
